node: Compound-semiconductor epitaxy tools for lasers and optical connectivity
summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the US-tradable universe around compound-semiconductor epitaxy and adjacent InP laser-manufacturing capacity. The cleanest US-listed direct equipment candidate found is Veeco, which disclosed more than $250M of orders for InP laser manufacturing tools tied to AI optical infrastructure. Aixtron remains the key non-US reference peer available via OTC ADR, but it should be treated as a context/reference name rather than a clean US-exchange small/mid-cap. AXT is not an equipment vendor but is a strong second-order substrate chokepoint candidate because its InP backlog and capacity expansion can validate demand for epitaxy and laser tool capacity. Lumentum is included only as a reference demand anchor for InP photonic chips and internal wafer-fab capacity, not as an underfollowed small/mid-cap discovery name.
